subject: Fixed build warning - wrong inculde path (cmake) (#75)
reason: The change is a one-line CMake fix in vmsdk/testing/CMakeLists.txt that corrects the include path (a source-list variable mistakenly used as a directory) for the concurrency_test unit-test executable. It is a build/CI-only change affecting how a test binary compiles; no module runtime code, command behaviour, reply, or data path changes, so no fuzzer scenario can exercise it.
